subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: How should maintainers split #86567 across dashboard auth recovery, Codex/OpenAI OAuth propagation, runtime update atomicity, and context/final-turn liveness contracts?
rationale: The remaining work changes credential persistence, provider auth propagation, upgrade behavior, runtime package contracts, and terminal session semantics, which are product/security boundary choices rather than a safe autonomous repair.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Keep this umbrella as coordination and make each active subproblem own its security contract, implementation path, and proof requirements.

options.title: Close After Canonical Links
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers designate narrower open issues as the sole canonical tracking items for every remaining acceptance criterion.

options.title: Run A Broad Reliability Program
options.body: Treat the issue as one maintainer-led reliability project spanning auth, installer, runtime, and context-management rather than ClawSweeper automation.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella as coordination and make each active subproblem own its security contract, implementation path, and proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged history in the agent terminal-state and OpenAI/Codex auth surfaces that anchor the split decision.
